transcript:
Meeting header
Date/Time: 2025-05-14 10:00 PDT
Duration: ~45 minutes
Attendees: Jordan (Redwood), Leah (Redwood), Samir (Redwood), Maya (Redwood AE), Evan (Redwood Ops), Alex (LaunchPad), Priya (LaunchPad)

Summary:
Quick sync on the upcoming Q2 webinar (developer-first inference panel) with LaunchPad Events as co-host. Main goals: finalize registration page, confirm promotion channels (email, LinkedIn, partner network), lock speaker bios/slides, set rehearsal date. Discussed segmentation, promo code allocation, paid spend, and success metrics (registrations, attendance, pipeline).

Topics:
- Registration page & promo codes
- Email cadence and segmentation
- Paid channel plan (LinkedIn, programmatic retargeting)
- Partner promotional commitments and assets
- Speaker logistics and dry run schedule
- Measurement & reporting

Transcript body:
[00:00] Jordan (Redwood): OK, let's kick off. Thanks everyone for joining. I think we've got, like, 30 minutes ish for the sync, just to lock campaign details. Alex, Priya, thanks for co-hosting with LaunchPad.
[00:12] Alex (LaunchPad): Yeah thanks, excited to partner. We did a quick run with our events calendar and the 28th looks open, is that still the target date?
[00:20] Jordan (Redwood): Yep, 2025-05-28 is the target. We need registration live by the 20th at the latest so we can do two weeks of email and paid.
[00:28] Priya (LaunchPad): Great. On assets, we can commit a homepage banner, social posts, and inclusion in our partner newsletter. We'll need the landing page URL and promo codes to link.
[00:40] Leah (Redwood): Quick Q — for promo codes, how many unique codes do we want? We can do a single global code or partner-specific codes so we can track conversions. Partner-specific is helpful for attribution but more setup.
[00:52] Jordan (Redwood): I vote partner-specific. Alex, can you confirm if LaunchPad can use a unique code for your list?
[00:58] Alex (LaunchPad): Yes, we can. We'll also do a tracked UTM for the newsletter link.
[01:04] Samir (Redwood): On slides and bios—Samir here—I'll finalize the panel slide and do short 2-3 sentence bios for each speaker. Can someone confirm the speaker list one more time?
[01:12] Maya (Redwood AE): Maya from AE — panel will be: Maya (Redwood, AE on inference), Lina (Customer panel — TBD), and Raj (Open-source maintainer, invited). We're still confirming Lina and Raj but expect confirmations by end of week.
[01:25] Evan (Redwood Ops): For the platform, are we using Zoom Webinars or LaunchPad's webinar tool? Need to confirm AV requirements.
[01:32] Alex (LaunchPad): LaunchPad can host but we recommend Zoom for larger registrant numbers. We can provide the registration page if preferred.
[01:40] Jordan (Redwood): Let's have Redwood host via Zoom webinar; Evan can set up the Zoom link and we'll embed registration on Redwood landing page with redirect to LaunchPad's promotional links.
[01:48] Leah (Redwood): Cool. For email cadence: suggested three sends — announcement, reminder 1 (3 days before), reminder 2 (day of). Also a targeted segment for previous webinar attendees and warm leads. We'll A/B subject lines.
[02:02] Jordan (Redwood): Agree. Leah, can you draft the cadence and share by Friday?
[02:06] Leah (Redwood): Yep I'll share by 2025-05-16.
[02:09] Samir (Redwood): Paid channels — we should plan LinkedIn sponsored content and retargeting to site visitors. Budget?
[02:15] Jordan (Redwood): We have a modest budget — $3k-$5k recommended. Prior webinars saw decent CPL on LinkedIn around $25-40, but that's variable. Thoughts?
[02:26] Alex (LaunchPad): We can co-fund promotional spots if Redwood wants to increase reach; LaunchPad can also boost a few posts on our channels.
[02:33] Priya (LaunchPad): Also we'll add to our partner newsletter with a top banner and an editorial blurb. That historically drives good weekday registrations.
[02:41] Maya (Redwood AE): One point on messaging — let's emphasize production-ready inference and real-world cost/latency tradeoffs. Avoid super-technical deep-dive in the marketing copy; reserve the deep technical content for the panel and post-webinar resources (like a whitepaper).
[02:56] Samir (Redwood): Noted. I'll write copy around 'production-grade inference' and 'unified runtime for hosted & private deployments' but simplify language.
[03:07] Jordan (Redwood): Measurement — KPIs are registrations, attendance (target 40% attendance rate), MQLs created, and pipeline influence (meetings booked after). We'll track via Marketo/GA and partner UTMs.
[03:20] Evan (Redwood Ops): I'll set up event tracking and a lead flow to the CRM. Also will export the registration list daily during the campaign.
[03:27] Priya (LaunchPad): On logistics, how long is the webinar? 60 minutes? 45?
[03:33] Jordan (Redwood): Plan for 60 minutes: 10-15 min intros, 35-40 min panel + Q&A.
[03:40] Alex (LaunchPad): Sounds good. Any gating on the content—like we need legal to approve customer quotes?
[03:46] Maya (Redwood AE): If we include a customer quote or case study, we'll need signoff. But if it's just a customer on the panel, they can speak live—legal will want post-event recording review.
[03:56] Samir (Redwood): Speaking of recording, we should prepare a post-webinar asset plan: edited recording, short clips for social, and a follow-up content piece (blog + benchmark sheet). Who owns that?
[04:08] Jordan (Redwood): Samir will own post-webinar assets. Leah will own the follow-up nurture.
[04:14] Leah (Redwood): For follow-ups, propose a 3-email nurture: thanks + recording, highlights + CTA to demo, and a final 'missed you' with gated benchmark. We'll map that to segments.
[04:25] Alex (LaunchPad): We'll promote the recording on our channels too.
[04:28] Jordan (Redwood): Great. Now quick discussion on segmentation: Leah?
[04:31] Leah (Redwood): Target lists: previous webinar attendees, users who have tried the Hosted API free tier, current trial accounts for Dedicated, and our enterprise target list. We'll suppress recent customers. We'll create lists in Marketo and share sample counts by Friday.
[04:46] Samir (Redwood): Are we doing any influencer outreach or paid ad targeting to specific job titles?
[04:50] Jordan (Redwood): Yes target job titles: ML Engineers, ML Platform, Product Engineers, Platform team leads. We'll tailor ad creative for those verticals.
[04:58] Evan (Redwood Ops): On the tech side, a quick note: Samir mentioned 'KV cash' in the draft — just a heads-up the copy should say 'KV cache' and maybe 'batching & caching' spelled correctly. Typos in tech terms confuse audiences.
[05:11] Samir (Redwood): Oh yeah, thanks — my bad. Will correct.
[05:15] Maya (Redwood AE): Anything else from LaunchPad on promo timing?
[05:18] Alex (LaunchPad): We'll run a newsletter slot on 05-22 and a social push the week of the webinar. We'll need the landing page by 05-20 to wire links.
[05:27] Jordan (Redwood): OK. Recap of deadlines: landing page live 05-20, emails and slides 05-16, partner assets 05-15, rehearsal 05-21.
[05:35] Priya (LaunchPad): Quick ask — can Redwood provide a short script for partners to use in their newsletter? A 2-3 sentence blurb.
[05:42] Samir (Redwood): I'll draft a partner blurb and send it to Alex by Friday.
[05:46] Jordan (Redwood): Great. Any blockers?
[05:49] Alex (LaunchPad): No blockers. We just need the promo codes and the final landing page.
[05:53] Leah (Redwood): I'll create two partner-specific promo codes: LAUNCHPAD10 and REDWOOD10 — or do we want unique ones per partner?
[06:02] Jordan (Redwood): Let's do partner specific: LAUNCHPAD10 for LaunchPad and REDWOOD10 for Redwood-owned channels. Good for attribution.
[06:10] Evan (Redwood Ops): I'll make sure codes are in Marketo and linked on the landing page.
[06:15] Jordan (Redwood): Last thing — rehearsal. Propose 05-21 9am PT for a 60-minute dry run with speakers, ops, and Alex. Evan can own calendar invite.
[06:25] Evan (Redwood Ops): I'll send invite after the call.
[06:28] Jordan (Redwood): Perfect. That should cover it. Thanks everyone.

Recap / Next Steps:
- Landing page live by 2025-05-20 (Jordan/Evan)
- Email cadence + segments by 2025-05-16 (Leah)
- Slides + speaker bios by 2025-05-16 (Samir)
- Partner assets & promo codes by 2025-05-15 (Alex)
- Rehearsal scheduled for 2025-05-21 09:00 PT (Evan)
- Post-webinar assets plan and nurture owner confirmed (Samir/Leah)

Shared artifacts / links referenced:
- Draft slides (Samir) - link: https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/EXAMPLE-SLIDES (placeholder)
- Registration page (to be published) - example: https://redwood.ai/webinars/q2-inference (placeholder)
- Promo tracker spreadsheet - link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/EXAMPLE-TRACKER (placeholder)

End of transcript.
